items.title: 56799_Red Norvo oral history interview
items.q: the next night Teddy and Peanuts and Jack Lesberg and the drummer, we had a sextet

ctx.x: So, he said -- I told him I wasn't going to play and this that, I quit and he said, well, forget that, come as a guest. So I went as a guest and some band had been there and there was a vibraphone there, and they called and I went up

and said that -- Dick Hyman who had worked with me before, said "Dick, I have no idea that piano rumbles in my ears, I have no idea what's going to happen, and I'm scared." He said, Dick said, "Just play." Everybody around you has worked with you, and they're with you. So I played. And I tried to shut out things that would bother, and I got through, so the next night Teddy and Peanuts and Jack Lesberg and the drummer, we had a sextet and so Peanuts wanted me to do it. I said, "Oh, I don't think I should. I can…
And, I did it. And I think if I hadn't done it that quick after the operation I'd have never played.
